# miwale Game Style Library

> 20 complete, playable visual styles for 2D games, each documented in enough detail that an AI can reproduce it: exact palette (hex), fonts, rendering technique, characters, effects, UI, motion, do/don't rules, a step-by-step recipe and dependency-free starter code (Canvas 2D).

Use it when you have to give a game a distinct, coherent art style. Pick the style that fits the requested mood and genre, read its STYLE.md completely and follow its rules; start from its starter.js. All styles are free to copy and adapt.

Every style ships three files: `STYLE.md` (full spec, start here), `spec.json` (design tokens), `starter.js` (standalone code with palette, core drawing helpers and a `draw(ctx, w, h, t)` preview). The full reference implementation of each style is the Canvas 2D module under `js/styles/<id>.js`, written for the top-down survival game "Jack vs. the Turnip Ancestors" (hero, small/fast/large enemies, pickups, projectiles, props, HUD).

## Styles

- [Harvest 16-Bit](https://miwale.com/styles/library/harvest16/STYLE.md): Pixel Art · SNES 16-bit. Cozy SNES-era autumn farmland: warm hue-shifted pixel sprites, leaf-litter carpets, furrowed fields and wooden HUD panels. Best for: top-down action / survivor games, farming and life sims, cozy RPGs, Halloween / harvest themed games, roguelites with readable hordes. Difficulty 5/10.
- [Pumpkin Boy](https://miwale.com/styles/library/kuerbisboy/STYLE.md): Pixel Art · 4 Colours. A pumpkin-tinted handheld LCD: exactly four shades, Bayer dithering, crisp outlined mini sprites at 2 world units per pixel. Best for: survivor-likes and arena shooters, top-down adventure / zelda-likes, farming or harvest games with a spooky twist, game jams with a strict palette, monster-collecting RPGs. Difficulty 4/10.
- [Gothic Night](https://miwale.com/styles/library/gothic/STYLE.md): Pixel Art · Dark. Moonlit cursed churchyard in detailed pixel art: a banded light map darkens a cold world; only faces, lanterns and candles glow warm. Best for: top-down action / survivor games, horror roguelites, dungeon crawlers, Halloween-themed games, stealth or light-radius games. Difficulty 6/10.
- [Dusk Grove](https://miwale.com/styles/library/dusk/STYLE.md): Pixel Art · Modern HD-2D. Modern HD-2D pixel art: an enchanted forest clearing at golden-to-violet dusk, rim-lit sprites, banded glows, bloom and long shadows. Best for: top-down action roguelites, survivor-likes, cozy adventure RPGs, fairy-tale exploration games, farming/forest games with a night cycle. Difficulty 7/10.
- [Brotato Cartoon](https://miwale.com/styles/library/cartoon/STYLE.md): Vector · Cartoon. Candy-bright HD vector cartoon: thick deep-plum outlines, one cel-shade crescent, one white gloss and bouncy squash & stretch. Best for: horde survival / bullet-heaven games, top-down arena shooters, casual mobile action, party and co-op games, kid-friendly adventure. Difficulty 3/10.
- [Paper World](https://miwale.com/styles/library/paper/STYLE.md): Papercraft · Cut-paper diorama. A handmade craft-table diorama: cut construction-paper puppets with white sticker rims and brass split pins on layered kraft, felt and newsprint. Best for: top-down action / survivor games, cozy adventure and farming games, puzzle and board-game adaptations, kids' and family games, seasonal or holiday themes. Difficulty 6/10.
- [Watercolor Storybook](https://miwale.com/styles/library/watercolor/STYLE.md): Illustrated · Watercolor. Transparent watercolour washes and loose, broken ink lines on warm cold-pressed paper: a living illustrated fairy-tale book. Best for: top-down survivor / action games with a fairy-tale theme, cozy adventure and farming games, story-driven RPGs and visual-novel maps, board-game or storybook map screens. Difficulty 8/10.
- [Neon Midnight](https://miwale.com/styles/library/neon/STYLE.md): Vector · Neon. Glowing neon tube line-art with baked halos on a near-black holographic floor of circuit, hex and halftone regions. Best for: arcade shooters and survivor-likes, twin-stick and bullet-hell games, rhythm and music games, retro-futuristic puzzle games, top-down action with many enemies. Difficulty 3/10.
- [Low-Poly Diorama](https://miwale.com/styles/library/lowpoly/STYLE.md): 3D Look · Low Poly. A toy-like autumn miniature world of flat-shaded triangle facets in soft afternoon light, with tilt-shift blur at the screen edges. Best for: top-down survivor / horde games, cozy farming or village sims, tactics and strategy maps, casual puzzle-adventure, idle / builder games. Difficulty 5/10.
- [Linocut](https://miwale.com/styles/library/linocut/STYLE.md): Printmaking · Linocut. A moving linocut print: cream paper, carbon-black key plate, one misregistered pumpkin-orange spot plate and a sparing teal. Best for: top-down action and survivor games, folk-horror and fairy-tale games, card and board games, narrative / visual-novel art, puzzle games with strong silhouettes. Difficulty 6/10.
- [8-Bit Arcade](https://miwale.com/styles/library/nes8bit/STYLE.md): Pixel Art · NES 8-bit. A lost NES cartridge: strict 2C02 palette, black-outlined 3-colour sprites, tile-language meadows and checker-flicker ghosts. Best for: top-down action / survivor games, arcade shooters, retro platformers and Zelda-likes, game jams with strict rules, chiptune rhythm or score-attack games. Difficulty 3/10.
- [Cathedral Glass](https://miwale.com/styles/library/stainedglass/STYLE.md): Mosaic · Stained Glass. A living cathedral window: jewel-tone glass pieces in dark lead came, lit from behind by warm light and coloured rays. Best for: top-down survivor / horde games, fairy-tale action RPGs, puzzle and match games, holiday or harvest-themed arcade games, card and board game UIs. Difficulty 7/10.
- [Clay World](https://miwale.com/styles/library/clay/STYLE.md): Claymation · Stop-motion plasticine. Stop-motion plasticine miniature set: soft gradient-built clay figures with fingerprints, warm studio light and 12 fps boil. Best for: top-down survivor / action games, cozy adventures and farming, puzzle and party games, family-friendly platformers seen from above, casual mobile games. Difficulty 5/10.
- [Chalkboard](https://miwale.com/styles/library/chalk/STYLE.md): Traditional media · Chalk. Drawn live with pastel chalk on a slate-green school board: broken grainy strokes, loose hatching, eraser smears and doodles. Best for: top-down survivor / horde games, kids and educational games, cozy Halloween games, puzzle and board-game adaptations, sketchbook-themed platformers. Difficulty 5/10.
- [Trick or Treat](https://miwale.com/styles/library/candy/STYLE.md): Rendered Cartoon · Candy Gloss. A glossy Halloween candy world: hard-candy shine, gummy jelly, matte marshmallow and chocolate on a melting chocolate floor. Best for: cute horde survivors, casual arcade games, match/puzzle games with characters, holiday events, kids-friendly action. Difficulty 6/10.
- [Cross-Stitch Sampler](https://miwale.com/styles/library/crossstitch/STYLE.md): Textile · Cross-stitch embroidery. The whole game is a living cross-stitch sampler on Aida cloth: every cell is a real thread X, contours are backstitched. Best for: top-down survivors / arena games, cozy farming or adventure games, puzzle and board-like games on a grid, seasonal or holiday games, roguelites with small readable sprites. Difficulty 3/10.
- [Pop-Art Comic](https://miwale.com/styles/library/popart/STYLE.md): Comic · Pop-Art print. A printed 1960s comic book come alive: brush-ink outlines, flat process colours, Ben-Day dots and slipped colour plates. Best for: arena survivors / bullet heaven, beat-'em-ups and brawlers, top-down action with big hordes, superhero or Halloween party games, card/upgrade screens with strong UI. Difficulty 5/10.
- [Starry Night](https://miwale.com/styles/library/vangogh/STYLE.md): Traditional media · Impasto oil painting. A living Van Gogh night painting: every surface is thick, swirling impasto brush strokes in ultramarine, viridian and cadmium yellow. Best for: top-down action / survivor games, atmospheric adventure games, art-themed or museum games, cozy night exploration, short arthouse games. Difficulty 8/10.
- [Shadow Theatre](https://miwale.com/styles/library/shadow/STYLE.md): Silhouette · Paper Shadow Puppets. Backlit paper shadow-puppet theatre: indigo-black cut-paper silhouettes over glowing teal, violet, crimson and amber light fields. Best for: survivor-likes and hordes with many enemies, halloween or folklore action games, puzzle-platformers with silhouette art, storybook adventures, rhythm games with a stage theme. Difficulty 4/10.
- [Voxel Cube World](https://miwale.com/styles/library/voxel/STYLE.md): 3D Look · Voxel. A bright MagicaVoxel-style miniature world: every actor is a real 3D cube grid, baked to sprites under one warm afternoon sun. Best for: top-down survivor / arena games, farming and village sims, tactics and roguelikes, builder and puzzle games, casual mobile action. Difficulty 3/10.

## Machine-readable

- [Catalog (JSON)](https://miwale.com/styles/styles.json): every style with tags, palette, fonts, difficulty and file links
- [All specs in one file](https://miwale.com/styles/llms-full.txt): every STYLE.md concatenated
- [Authoring format](https://miwale.com/styles/library/AUTHORING.md): schema of spec.json, STYLE.md and starter.js
